title: feat: covering tests before a PR, and 2 auto-fix rounds at most
headline: Before a PR only the tests that cover the change run locally and CI runs the rest, and auto-fix gathers every comment first, fixes each class at its root and stops after two fix rounds.
alignment: v1.32.0 lands the five rows the kit found on itself about local test runs and the review loop, each reproduced on the released 1.31.0 first.

items.text: Auto-fix makes at most 2 fix rounds per PR: the merge gate counts the pushes this clone logged, refuses a third and names the owner. A log it cannot write, or a PR number with a leading zero, stops the push.
items.where: A third auto-fix push on one PR

items.text: The kit's test runner prints a notice on a full local run: CI runs the suite on every PR and push, and a change takes the changed run.

One local-test rule: before a PR, run the tests covering the change, and CI's run on the push is the gate; with no CI on the PR the full suite runs once locally. The test-first, loop, team build and PR body texts agree.
items.before: The full suite, then CI again
items.after: The covering tests; CI runs the rest

items.text: Auto-fix gathers every CI failure and review comment first, fixes each class once at its root, runs the covering tests and pushes once.
items.before: A fix and a push per comment
items.after: Every comment, each root once, one push

verification: Each code change has a test that fails on the code before it: the third push and the leading-zero PR number for the round cap, and the notice on a full run; all five rows were first reproduced on the released 1.31.0.
Recall on keys v10: candidate median 14, baseline (1.31.0) 14, control 0.

decisions.decision: The round cap counts the gate log's pushes per PR
decisions.why: Every auto-fix push already writes one line there; a plain push to the branch is not counted, and the rule line covers that path.

decisions.decision: The notice never holds a run
decisions.why: A full local run is still right where no CI runs, so the runner tells and the exit code is unchanged.
